facts.fact: The Analyst reports that Liberia's Cybercrime Act, which Senator Konneh voted for, was recently passed and is the subject of first enforcement actions (no passage date given, so the 2026-09-24 publication date is used).

The Analyst reports the arrest of Jerry Nyantee Wrato over AI-generated images and videos of Vice President Koung, and says the Liberia National Police will forward him to court on four counts under the Cybercrime Act of 2025; the charges are untested in court (arrest date not given, 2026-09-24 publication date used).
